# #3254: CI: a patches promotion or log is stuck
Opened by @github-actions[bot].

<!-- stuck #3248 -->
The card-patch promotion https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/pull/3248 (`patches ship`, R646) has been open over 2 hours and did not merge itself:

- [web (unit 4/4)](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42105281351/job/127557836659)
- [web](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42105281351/job/127567641522)

Until it merges, the patches it ships are not live as versions: `CATALOG_VERSION` stays where it was and the patch notes do not show them.

Fix it on a branch from main: a check that only fails here usually reads the shipped history (`crates/cards/patches/`) and must hold for the history this promotion ships, so check out its branch and run the failing tests there to see it fail first, then show them pass there with the fix. A conflict alone needs no fix. Close this issue with the fix's pull request (or, for a conflict alone, by hand); the watch in `.github/workflows/patches-ship.yml` then ships again from the newer main, and that promotion supersedes this one.

If they are red for a reason outside the repository (CI out of minutes, a spending limit, billing, an account, a runner that never started), no change here fixes it: open the plan with a `**Human required:**` line saying what a person must do, and build nothing.

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `claude-7` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/42123694763)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Promotion #3248 (`patches ship: v0.5.11s, v0.5.12`, branch `patches/ship-b0661b6104`, head `f4dbacc0c8`) is red on `web (unit 4/4)`, and so on `web`. The cause is inside the repository. `apps/web/src/wording.test.ts`'s test `R724001 R1369000 no player note in patches.json or line of technical.json says library, sacrifice, an old cost form, Degrade or Upgrade` fails on one v0.5.12 player-note line: `"Spiritually 中国's transformed cards keep their own cost instead of costing (1)."`. "costing (1)" is an old cost form under R432 (`/\bcosting \(/i`). The line comes from the pending fragment `crates/cards/patches/pending/stinkyscape-balance-pass-starship-tag-marketplace-prices.json` on `main`. That test reads only `patches.json`, so `main` stays green until the fragment ships.

Done means:
1. The fragment's line is in today's words, so the next promotion from `main` passes.
2. `wording.test.ts` also checks every pending fragment's player note, so a note like this fails on its own pull request, not at its promotion.
3. R724001's note and `docs/issues-and-patches.md` say so.
4. The builder shows the test failing on the promotion's commit, then passing there with the fix, as the issue asks.

**What the planner ran.** These ran in a detached worktree of `f4dbacc0c8`, with the module built by `JACKIOH_WASM_LUAU=0 sh scripts/build-wasm.sh`; that worktree has since been removed.
- `pnpm exec vitest run --project web apps/web/src/wording.test.ts`: `Tests 1 failed | 14 passed (15)`, failing on exactly the line above.
- CI's shard 4/4 command, run in full: `Test Files 1 failed | 115 passed (116)`, `Tests 1 failed | 2303 passed (2304)`. Nothing else fails.
- With the reworded line in that worktree's `patches.json`, the test file gave `15 passed`.
- With the test change below in that worktree:
  - It failed on `main`'s unfixed fragment (`pending/stinkyscape-…json balance: "…costing (1)."`).
  - It passed once the fragment was fixed, and passed with no `pending/` directory.
  - `eslint` and `tsc` passed, and `ci-scope.test.ts -t "patches/pending"` passed.

## Files to touch

| Path | Kind | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/cards/patches/pending/stinkyscape-balance-pass-starship-tag-marketplace-prices.json` | change | Line 57, one string of `player.balance` |
| `apps/web/src/wording.test.ts` | change | Add `existsSync` to the import; `playerNoteTexts()` also reads `crates/cards/patches/pending/*.json`; its doc comment; the R724001 test's title |
| `spec/rulings/R724001.md` | change | One clause of the body (line 9) |
| `docs/issues-and-patches.md` | change | The "Today's words" bullet (line 362) |

Do not touch:
- `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `.claude/`.
- `crates/cards/patches/patches.json`, `shipped.json`, `index.json`, `technical.json`, any snapshot, `win_rates/`, `card_metrics/`, or the other fragment.
- `crates/server/.env.example`, `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md`.
- Any Rust crate, and `scripts/ci-scope.sh`, which needs no change: `crates/cards/*` already turns `web` on through its `*) on web` case.

No new ruling: this is the existing R724001 (with R432 and R646), now checked earlier.

## Steps

1. **`apps/web/src/wording.test.ts`, the import (line 6).** Change it to:
   `import { existsSync, readdirSync, readFileSync, statSync } from "node:fs";`

2. **`apps/web/src/wording.test.ts`, the doc comment above `playerNoteTexts()` (line 242).** Replace it with:
   ```ts
   /**
    * R724001: the player notes `patches.json` carries and every pending fragment's (`patches ship` copies a
    * fragment's onto the patch it ships, R646, so its note is held here before it ships), every title and
    * line of each, and the technical log's lines (R1369000).
    */
   ```

3. **`playerNoteTexts()`, between the `patches` const and the `technical` const.** Insert exactly:
   ```ts
     // A promotion deletes every fragment, and git keeps no empty directory.
     const pendingDir = join(SRC, "../../../crates/cards/patches/pending");
     const pending = (existsSync(pendingDir) ? readdirSync(pendingDir) : [])
       .filter((name) => name.endsWith(".json"))
       .map((name) => {
         const fragment = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(pendingDir, name), "utf8")) as { player?: Record<string, string | string[]> };
         return { version: `pending/${name}`, player: fragment.player };
       });
   ```
   - The `existsSync` guard is required: `pending/` does not exist on a promotion branch. Without the guard, every promotion would go red.

4. **The return of `playerNoteTexts()`.** Change `...patches.flatMap(({ version, player }) =>` to `...[...patches, ...pending].flatMap(({ version, player }) =>`. Leave the rest of the function as it is.
   - `R781000 a player note says Magnetic only to name its rename to Equip` calls the same function, so it now covers fragments too.

5. **Run the test now, before fixing the fragment** (command under Tests). It must fail, and the failing list must be exactly:
   `"pending/stinkyscape-balance-pass-starship-tag-marketplace-prices.json balance: \"Spiritually 中国's transformed cards keep their own cost instead of costing (1).\""`.

6. **The R724001 test's title (line 264).** Change the string to:
   `"R724001 R1369000 no player note in patches.json or a pending fragment, and no line of technical.json, says library, sacrifice, an old cost form, Degrade or Upgrade"`.
   Keep the body as it is.

7. **The fragment, line 57.** Replace exactly
   `"Spiritually 中国's transformed cards keep their own cost instead of costing (1).",`
   with
   `"Spiritually 中国's transformed cards keep their own cost; they no longer cost (1).",`
   - Use an exact string edit and keep the indentation, the trailing comma and every other byte of the file.
   - The new line is 80 characters. It matches none of the wording guards and none of `patches check`'s note rules.
   - It keeps the meaning: since #3140 the transformed cards cost their printed price, where through v0.5.11r they cost (1). See `crates/cards/src/scripts/meditative/c032_spiritually_zhongguo.rs`'s header.

8. **`spec/rulings/R724001.md`, line 9.** Replace
   ``: `wording.test.ts` holds every title and line of `patches.json`'s notes to them).``
   with
   ``: `wording.test.ts` holds every title and line of `patches.json`'s notes, and of every pending fragment's, to them).``
   Do not change the front matter or the title.

9. **`docs/issues-and-patches.md`, line 362.** Replace
   ``  R1320): `apps/web/src/wording.test.ts` checks every note in `patches.json`.``
   with these two lines:
   ```
     R1320): `apps/web/src/wording.test.ts` checks every note in `patches.json` and every pending
     fragment's, so an old word fails the fragment's own pull request, not its promotion.
   ```

10. **Show it on the promotion's commit.** Everything here happens in a scratch worktree; nothing from it is delivered.
    1. From the builder's worktree, run `JACKIOH_WASM_LUAU=0 sh scripts/build-wasm.sh` if `apps/web/src/wasm/pkg` is missing.
    2. Create the worktree:
       `git worktree add --detach ../jackioh-wt/ship-3248 f4dbacc0c8 && (cd ../jackioh-wt/ship-3248 && pnpm install --prefer-offline --silent)`
    3. Copy the module in: `cp -r apps/web/src/wasm/pkg ../jackioh-wt/ship-3248/apps/web/src/wasm/`. The promotion changes only `crates/cards/patches/` and `.env.example`, and the wording test reads no WASM value.
    4. In `../jackioh-wt/ship-3248`, run `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/wording.test.ts`. Expect 1 failed, on `v0.5.12 balance: …costing (1).`.
    5. Apply step 7's replacement to that worktree's `crates/cards/patches/patches.json`:
       `sed -i "s/keep their own cost instead of costing (1)\./keep their own cost; they no longer cost (1)./" crates/cards/patches/patches.json`
       Rerun the test and expect `15 passed`.
    6. Copy the builder's edited `apps/web/src/wording.test.ts` over that worktree's copy and rerun. Expect `15 passed`, which proves the test passes with no `pending/` directory.
    7. Remove it: `git worktree remove --force ../jackioh-wt/ship-3248`. Report the outputs you saw.

## Tests

The one test file changed is `apps/web/src/wording.test.ts`, the test `R724001 R1369000 no player note in patches.json or a pending fragment, and no line of technical.json, says library, sacrifice, an old cost form, Degrade or Upgrade`. It asserts that no title or line of any patch's note, of any pending fragment's note or of `technical.json` matches R373, R432 or R1320's guards. It fails on `main` without step 7 (step 5) and passes with it.

Commands, from the builder's worktree (after `JACKIOH_WASM_LUAU=0 sh scripts/build-wasm.sh`):
- `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/wording.test.ts`
- `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/net/ci-scope.test.ts -t "patches/pending"`. Expect 1 passed: `runs web for crates/cards/patches/pending/x, which apps/web/src/wording.test.ts names`.
- `pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/wording.test.ts`
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`
- `cargo jackioh patches check`
- `cargo jackioh spec check`
- `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims`. This change adds no catalog or play change, and the fragment's `visual`/`rule` flags are as on `main`.

## Done when

- [ ] Step 5 seen failing on the pending fragment's line, before step 7.
- [ ] The fragment's line reads `…keep their own cost; they no longer cost (1).`, and the file is otherwise byte-identical.
- [ ] `wording.test.ts` passes with the fragment fixed.
- [ ] On `f4dbacc0c8`: seen failing, then passing with the reworded line in `patches.json`, then passing with the new test and no `pending/` (step 10). Scratch worktree removed.
- [ ] R724001 and `docs/issues-and-patches.md` edited as in steps 8 and 9.
- [ ] The Tests commands above pass.
- [ ] The harness checks pass: rustfmt, catalog, patches, rulings, clippy, cargo tests, web tests.
- [ ] The PR closes #3254.

## Risks

- **Every future promotion going red.** A promotion branch has no `pending/` directory, so `readdirSync` without the `existsSync` guard would throw on every promotion. Keep the guard; step 10's third run proves it.
- **Breaking the fragment's JSON or note rules** (`patches check`, R724001: line ≤ 200 characters, no `R<n>`, `#<n>` or `§`). Edit only that one string. `patches check` passes on the fragment as it is.
- **Claims.** `classify --claims` (R1370000) compares the head fragment's `visual`/`rule` to the base's. Both stay `true`, so no new claim is asked. No card's data or play changes, so no new fragment is needed.
- **CI scope.** The test newly names `crates/cards/patches/pending`. `ci-scope.sh` already runs `web` for it, and `ci-scope.test.ts` holds that (checked).
- No effect on determinism, replay or hidden information: only test and data text change.

## Open questions

None needs a person.

Decisions the task left open:
- **Where the guard lives.** It extends `wording.test.ts`, which R724001 already names as the holder of today's words. The rejected alternative was adding R373/R432/R1320's patterns to Rust's `player_note_problems` in `crates/tools/src/patches.rs`, which would keep the same rules in two languages.
- **The rewording.** "keep their own cost; they no longer cost (1)." was chosen over dropping the "(1)", because a balance line names the from-value.

#3248 needs no hand. Once this merges, the watch in `patches-ship.yml` ships again from the newer `main`, and that promotion supersedes #3248.
